answer: Sybil defence is a graduated bond escrowed behind a verified operator: a new agent locks 500 units for 30 days, and that bond doubles per account registered under the same operator, so ten clones pay 2^10 the base. Two established attesters must co-sign before it activates, and a rotating knoll audit samples 5% of identities each epoch, burning the whole ladder on any proven duplicate. The dune of fake identities cannot self-vouch upward, since attestation is gated by established peers, so each extra clone costs more than it earns. A walnut-shaped ledger records every burn publicly.
